title: Do Not Dare to Dream
label: Merge Records
pull_quote: We can still be cheerful and optimistic in the face of things not being great.
notes: 13th album, first since 2023's Nothing Lasts Forever. Recorded at Black Bay Studio on Great Bernera, Scotland. Singles so far: 'Day in the Sun' (July 2026, with video), 'There Was You' (per Backseat Mafia), 'Be With You Tonight' (per seed_notes; date not confirmed this pass). The quote is Raymond McGinley's.

title: All Over You
label: Merge Records
notes: Seventh album. Lead single 'Overdrive' (Aug. 4, 2026, video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zveNaOU2-zE) has a nod to the Sex Pistols. Title-track video posted Aug. 26. Press describes it as bubblegum, boy/girl harmonies, electro beats and grungy distortion. SF band.

title: Gentling the Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall
label: SUCK Records
notes: First release on Rose's own SUCK imprint. 11 tracks. Produced, engineered and mixed by John Congleton. Earlier singles: 'Yip Yip Yow' (lead) and 'Chow Mein'. 'Hello Again, Jim' (about toxic men in the music industry, released as an official live video) and 'Calm' came out together in mid-Sept. 2026 (SeeRockLive). NPR World Cafe feature Sept. 8.
